verdict.rationale: vLLM's own docs list hardware plugins for Google TPUs, Intel Gaudi, IBM Spyre, Huawei Ascend, and other accelerators, which directly matches running inference on specialized accelerators through plugins. The 'run any model on any hardware' positioning reinforces this. The evidence is a single high-level feature-list claim, though, with no setup or depth documentation. Missing for 10: plugin installation/configuration docs for TPU or Gaudi, details on feature parity or limitations per plugin, independent or hands-on corroboration of accelerator inference.
